div.head: I Em 5
div.ab: Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop béte Godes hus on his agenum ⁊ eac þone cyningc minegige, þæt ealle Godes circan syn wel behworfene, swa us micel þearf is.
Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop bete Godes hus on his agnum ⁊ eac þone cyning myngige, ðæt ealle Godes cyrcan syn wel behweorfene, swa us mucel þearf is.
Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop bete Godes hus on his agnum ⁊ eac ðone cyning myndgige, þæt ealle Godes cyrcan syn wel behwofene, swa us micel ðearf his.
Amplius diximus, ut omnis episcopus reficiat Dei domos in suo proprio et regem admoneat, ut omnes ecclesie Dei sint bene parate, sicut magnum nobis opus est.
[Be cyricena gebetunge.] Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop béte Godes hus on his agenum, ⁊ eac þone cyningc minegige, þæt ealle Godes circan syn wel behworfene, swa us micel þearf is.
Eac we gecwædon þæt ælc biscop bete Godes hus on his agenum, and eac þone cyningc minegige þæt ealle Godes circan syn wel behworfene, swa us micel þearf is.

(Über Instandhaltung der Kirchen. Ld) Ferner bestimmten wir, dass jeder Bischof auf seinem Eigen[gut] die Gotteshäuser gut in Stand halte und auch den König ermahne, dass alle Gotteskirchen wohl versehen seien, wie uns höchst nöthig ist.

(Of the upkeep of churches. Ld) Further we determined that every bishop keep the houses of God in good repair on his own [property] and also admonish the king that all God's churches be well provided for, as is most needful for us.

Likewise we have ordained that every bishop shall restore the houses of God on his own property, and also exhort the king that all God's churches be well put in order, as we have much need [that they be].
Furthermore, we command each bishop to restore the houses of God in his own see, and also to admonish the king that all God’s churches are to be attended to properly, as is greatly required of us.

note.seg: Be cyricena gebetunge rubric in Ld
Nicht ‘Distrikt, Sprengel’ (die Diözese heisst nicht des Bischofs ‘eigen’), vielmehr die Eigenkirchen und die Kirchen auf dem Grundbesitz des Bistums, Domstifts und des Bischofs persönlich

Not ‘district, diocese’ (the diocese is not called the bishop's ‘own’), but rather the proprietary churches and the churches on the landed property of the see, of the cathedral chapter and of the bishop personally
‘ausbessere’ zu eng. Q's Rubrik schliesst mit Recht allen kultischen Apparat ein. Vgl. Gl Kirchenbau 1
‘repair’ is too narrow. Q's rubric rightly includes all the apparatus of worship. Cf. Gl Kirchenbau 1
Odo schreibt coepiscopis, zur Seelsorge mahnend, quatinus rex Eadmundus cum populo imitari gaudeat quod in nobis et ex nobis audiat; Will. Malm. Pont. p. 23
Odo writes to his coepiscopis, exhorting them to pastoral care, quatinus rex Eadmundus cum populo imitari gaudeat quod in nobis et ex nobis audiat; Will. Malm. Pont. p. 23
behofen aus Ld hat Toller im Suppl. mit Recht gestrichen, es ist nur Ld's Fehler
Toller in the Suppl. has rightly deleted behofen, taken from Ld; it is merely Ld's error

Liebermann’s translation is ‘gut in Stand halte,’ but might not the reference be to the actual restoration of the churches which had been destroyed or had fallen into a dilapidated condition during the Danish wars? Oda himself had Canterbury Cathedral thoroughly repaired (see Angl. Sacr. ii. p. 83).
The churches here referred to are presumably on lands actually belonging to the cathedral or to the bishop himself. For churches on private estates see II Edg. 2.
